definitions.text: "the screw length was determined from the starting hole to the point where the probe touched but not perforated the anterior cortex. The nearest screw length to the measured length was chosen". No screw lengths by individual vertebral level are supplied; the regional usual lengths cite Kuraishi and are not independent observations.

"...measured as the distance between the posterior cortical entry point of the pedicle screw and the anterior vertebral cortex in line with the axis of the pedicle between T1 and L5." "The mean length of the longest screw that could be fixed was longer on the right side, except for T8 and T9." Fifteen right-side thoracic AIS patients. The abstract gives no per-level chord values.
